$comment: Fixtures for the generated acceptance tests: one entry per resource in the
IR, read by cmd/gen and rendered into internal/provider/<name>_resource_test.go.
The generator knows the shape of every test -- create, import, update,
destroy -- because that shape is the same for every resource and follows
from the spec. What it cannot know is a value: that an ipv4 attribute wants
10.42.2.0 and not the empty string, that renaming is the cheap way to prove
an update round-trips. Those are stated here, once, the way the overlay
states the wire facts.
JSON and not YAML because cmd/gen depends on nothing outside the standard
library, and that is worth more than the nicer quoting.
The sids below are seeded by test/docker-compose.yml: the api-server's own
migration creates the default service provider and account, with these
fixed ids, before the tests run.
`create` is deliberately the MINIMUM -- required attributes and nothing
else. That is not laziness, it is the point: an optional+computed attribute
left out of the configuration is planned as unknown, and an attribute still
unknown when apply returns is the failure these tests exist to catch.
Filling the block in would hide exactly the bug it is here to find.
sip_gateway carries inbound and outbound even though the schema calls them
optional: the columns are NOT NULL with no default, so MySQL rejects a create
without them --
Field 'inbound' doesn't have a default value
-- which the generated test found on its first run. is_active is still left
out, which is the point of the entry.
